answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 3370 Country: India Title: What is Islamic point of view about service in Commercial Banks? Question: What is Islamic point of view about service in Commercial Banks? Answer ID: 3370 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 307/262=B) If the bank is involved in interest transactions then it is not allowed to work with bank. It is narrated in hadith that the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) cursed one who eats interest, one who feeds interest, one who writes it and one who bears witness to it. They are equal in sin, he stated. (Mishkat: 244) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
